svg.text: ADC carrier on stripboard (toe carrier shown)
Component side. Copper strips run left–right underneath; red ✕ = cut the strip at that hole. 37 × 17 holes ≈ 94 × 43 mm.
wire link (component side; touches copper only at its dotted ends)
✕ cut the strip at this hole (from the copper side)
○ solder a bus wire here (5 per end)
○ CS wire from the UNO Q: solder to the top of the CS pin
○ solder the cell cable's E+ / E− / S here (JST is at the cradle)
■ breakout header pin (pins down, plastic spacer under the breakout)
Breakout pins by row (left|right column): A AGND|DGND · B AVDD|DVDD · C REFP0|CLK · D REFN0|CS · E AIN3|SCLK · F AIN2|MOSI · G AIN1|MISO · H AIN0|DRDY
Fit all links before the breakouts: they run underneath them. The tie links in columns 10 and 19 pass over cut holes; links only touch copper at their ends.
Not shown: R1/R2 solder on top of each breakout (AVDD–AIN1 and AIN1–AGND pins). L1's DRDY wire solders to L1's DRDY pin on top. Cable shields solder to strip O.
Heel carrier: identical board with L3, L4, R3, R4 (CS ← D5, D6, D9, A2); its BUS OUT pads stay empty.
